author: MiniWarGaming
description:
After several "Competitive" matched play games, we realized we were only using a fraction of the Matched Play deck. Today, Josh and Luka dare a 2,000-point Asymmetrical matched play game between the Orkz defending their compound and the Astra Militarum assailants.
